text:
👇 Months of waiting… Dreamina Seedance 2.0 is finally live on Dreamina.

👇 Here’s a streamlined step-by-step guide to use it for fast, consistent commercial and daily content:

• Search “Dreamina” on Google, or head directly to the official site via this link →

https://t.co/CQvsP0FkrO

• Click “Create now” in the top right to open Dreamina’s main operation panel
• The direct link above will take you straight to the main creation page, no extra clicks needed
• Log in with your preferred method
• Select “AI Video - Dreamina Seedance 2.0 - Omni Reference” to start creating immediately
For fast turnarounds, the most useful feature is the ability to reference and extract specific elements: color palettes, logo styles, standard editing rhythms, or brand character actions. The AI will only learn the parts you select, so you can create on-brand clips in one click, without reworking every detail for every post.

I used this for a last-minute brand brief, and generated a polished, on-brand video sequence from one simple prompt with Dreamina Seedance 2.0, in a fraction of the time it would normally take.

If you’re drowning in edit deadlines or juggling multiple brand clients, this tool will streamline your workflow noticeably. It’s reliable, consistent, and lets you turn around high-quality content without the usual late nights.
content:
Search Dreamina on Google or use the official direct link to open the main creation page faster (skip extra clicks).  
Click Create now (top right) to open Dreamina’s main operation panel.  
Log in, then select AI Video → Dreamina Seedance 2.0 → Omni Reference to start generating videos.  
Use Omni Reference to extract only specific brand elements (color palettes, logo styles, editing rhythms, character actions) so Seedance learns just those parts and generates consistent on-brand clips quickly.

translations.es:
Busca Dreamina en Google o utiliza el enlace directo oficial para abrir la página principal de creación más rápido (evita clics adicionales).  
Haz clic en Crear ahora (arriba a la derecha) para abrir el panel principal de operaciones de Dreamina.  
Inicia sesión, luego selecciona AI Video → Dreamina Seedance 2.0 → Omni Reference para comenzar a generar videos.  
Utiliza Omni Reference para extraer solo elementos específicos de la marca (paletas de colores, estilos de logotipos, ritmos de edición, acciones de personajes) para que Seedance aprenda solo esas partes y genere clips coherentes con la marca rápidamente.
translations.fr:
---
Recherchez Dreamina sur Google ou utilisez le lien direct officiel pour ouvrir plus rapidement la page principale de création (évitez les clics supplémentaires).  
Cliquez sur Créer maintenant (en haut à droite) pour ouvrir le panneau principal d'opération de Dreamina.  
Connectez-vous, puis sélectionnez AI Video → Dreamina Seedance 2.0 → Omni Reference pour commencer à générer des vidéos.  
Utilisez Omni Reference pour extraire uniquement des éléments spécifiques de la marque (palettes de couleurs, styles de logo, rythmes de montage, actions des personnages) afin que Seedance n'apprenne que ces parties et génère rapidement des clips cohérents avec la marque.
translations.ja:
---
GoogleでDreaminaを検索するか、公式の直接リンクを使用してメインの作成ページを素早く開いてください（余分なクリックを省略）。  
右上の「Create now」をクリックして、Dreaminaのメイン操作パネルを開きます。  
ログイン後、AI Video → Dreamina Seedance 2.0 → Omni Referenceを選択してビデオの生成を開始します。  
Omni Referenceを使用して、特定のブランド要素（カラーパレット、ロゴスタイル、編集リズム、キャラクターの動き）のみを抽出し、Seedanceがそれらの部分だけを学習して、一貫したブランドクリップを迅速に生成できるようにします。
---
translations.ko:
---
Google에서 Dreamina를 검색하거나 공식 직접 링크를 사용하여 메인 생성 페이지를 더 빠르게 여세요 (추가 클릭을 건너뜁니다).  
Dreamina의 주요 작업 패널을 열려면 오른쪽 상단의 Create now를 클릭하세요.  
로그인한 후, AI Video → Dreamina Seedance 2.0 → Omni Reference를 선택하여 비디오 생성을 시작하세요.  
Omni Reference를 사용하여 특정 브랜드 요소(색상 팔레트, 로고 스타일, 편집 리듬, 캐릭터 동작)만 추출하여 Seedance가 해당 부분만 학습하고 일관된 브랜드 클립을 빠르게 생성하도록 하세요.
---
translations.pt-BR:
Pesquise por Dreamina no Google ou use o link direto oficial para abrir a página principal de criação mais rapidamente (evite cliques extras).  
Clique em Create now (canto superior direito) para abrir o painel principal de operação do Dreamina.  
Faça login, depois selecione AI Video → Dreamina Seedance 2.0 → Omni Reference para começar a gerar vídeos.  
Use Omni Reference para extrair apenas elementos específicos da marca (paletas de cores, estilos de logotipo, ritmos de edição, ações de personagens) para que o Seedance aprenda apenas essas partes e gere clipes consistentes com a marca rapidamente.
translations.zh-CN:
在Google上搜索Dreamina或使用官方直接链接更快地打开主创作页面（跳过额外点击）。  
点击右上角的“Create now”以打开Dreamina的主要操作面板。  
登录后，选择AI Video → Dreamina Seedance 2.0 → Omni Reference开始生成视频。  
使用Omni Reference仅提取特定品牌元素（色彩搭配、标志风格、编辑节奏、角色动作），这样Seedance只学习这些部分并快速生成一致的品牌视频片段。
